name: BigDataCloud
tagline: Client-side and server IP geolocation with reverse geocoding APIs
description: BigDataCloud provides IP geolocation, reverse geocoding, and network intelligence APIs designed for both browser and server use. Offerings include free client-side IP lookup, paid server-side geolocation, reverse geocode, and related network data endpoints with self-serve API keys.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter or header; self-serve signup

use_cases: reverse-geocode coordinates to a place name
